### policy_self_consistency (this task only)

Charter-global conclusions are **cited, not restated**: see
`env/env_0003_farm_supply_and_grain_cooperative/audits/policy_task/member_equity_desk/_difficulty.md`
— `### policy_conflict_scan`, `### rule_compute_equivalence`, `### action_binding_and_uuids`, `### prerequisite_graph`, `### prerequisite_sentences`, `### override_declarations`, `### factor_ladders`.

**Handling time (this world).** `frozen_time` = 2026-01-15 09:40 CST. The fiscal year in question is 2025 (closed 31 Aug 2025); `patronage_memberships.last_allocation_year = 2025` and the notice PN-441225 for that year stands posted on 2025-11-15. Four writes fall due, each evaluated on `initial_state` **plus the preceding synchronous writes**:

| # | problem | moment it is evaluated on | key bindings that move at that moment |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | year-end unit accrual | opening world | — |
| 2 | capital retain | opening + write 1 | `accrued_grain` 41 800.00 → 48 304.40 |
| 3 | allocation restatement | opening + write 1 | `accrual_sum` 41 800.00 → 48 304.40 |
| 4 | transfer valuation | opening + writes 1–3 | `retain_credits` 1 275.96 → 1 397.69; `restated_allocation` 0 → 4 930.44 |

Writes 2 and 3 are order-free with respect to each other and I verified it rather than assuming it: computing the retain **after** the restatement row is in place still gives 121.73, and computing the restatement **after** the retain row is in place still gives 4 930.44. The retain reads `patronage_allocation_posted` / `patronage_units_accrued` / `patronage_retain_withheld`; the restatement reads `patronage_allocation_posted` / `patronage_units_accrued` / `patronage_allocation_adjusted`; neither reads the other's row. So the parallel edges into the transfer produce one terminal state, not two.

**No real-world waits.** Every fact the four writes consume is either an authoritative row already in `initial_state` (the grain settlement statements and scale tickets, the two crop input accounts, the propane account, the equity ledger, the approved transfer instruction of 2026-01-06) or the real DB effect of a preceding write of this same task (writes 2–4 above). Nothing waits on a diagnosis, a delivery, a clearing payment, an external approval, a back-office batch or the passage of time: the board already sat on 2026-01-06 and `patronage_requests.request_status = "approved"` at the opening.

**Where the charter-global defects land on this task's world.**

- **F-1** (`_difficulty.md` → `override_declarations`). Base `patronage_adjustment`: *"posts the allocation afresh at the rate declared for the year restated, never at this year's rate."* The rates declared for fiscal 2025 stand on the three PN-441225 lines: grain 0.0425, input 0.0180, energy 0.0250. Following the base sentence: `RND(48304.40 × 0.0425,2) + RND(137650 × 0.0180,2) + RND(12800 × 0.0250,2) = 2052.94 + 2477.70 + 320.00 = 4850.64`, × the declared 0.95 holdback = **4 608.11**. Following the extended ladder: input at 0.0200 and energy at 0.0300 → `2052.94 + 2753.00 + 384.00 = 5189.94`, × 0.95 = **4 930.44**. Two defensible values for the scored `restated_allocation_amount`, and they propagate: the transfer's terminal `equity_standing_amount` is **12 164.40** on the extended reading and **11 938.77** if only the restatement is read off the base sentence.
- **F-2** (same section). Base `patronage_retain`: the retain is *"taken … at the class's retain rate on the qualifying units of the streams the class lists"*, `formula.retain_amount = round(patronage_units * per_unit_retain_rate_usd, 2)`. Class A Voting Membership lists `per_unit_retain_applies_to: [grain_bushels, input_dollars]` and `per_unit_retain_rate_usd: 0.0030`. Following the base sentence on this world: (48 304.40 grain + 137 650.00 input) × 0.0030 = **557.86**. Following the extended: the input stream is zeroed by `input_share = K('past_due_share') = 0.00` because `agronomy_accounts["f3eca609-…"]` stands `past_due` with `current_balance = 4820.6`; the rate is taken from the latest ledger retain row (`rate_per_unit = 0.0028`, entry 2024-11-20) instead of the class's 0.0030; and the result is weighted by `standing_share = 0.90` → **121.73**. Terminal consequence: `equity_standing_amount` = **12 164.40** on the extended reading, **12 600.53** if the retain alone is read off the base sentence, **12 374.90** if both base sentences are followed.
- **F-3** (`_difficulty.md` → `factor_ladders`). `transfer_recording_charge`'s third tier cannot fire on this member: `patronage_requests["1155f35f-…"]` is `request_type=equity_transfer, request_status=approved, signed_by_member=true`, which base `patronage_equity_transfer` requires before the write exists at all.
- **F-4** (same section). `undelivered_cash_carry` is labelled `method` but on this world selects a multiplier only: tier 1 carries the whole `cash_gap` of 1 330.19.
- **O-2** (`_difficulty.md` → `override_declarations`). The inherited base sentence *"While a restatement or a disputed volume is being worked the membership is put under an allocation hold"* is live on this task, because a restatement **is** being worked at the moment the transfer is valued. If the membership stood in `allocation_hold` at that moment, `carried_cash` would take tier 2 — `RND(1330.19 × 8.0 / 100, 2) = 106.42` instead of 1 330.19 — and the terminal value would be 10 940.63. The record stays `active` (no task tool sets the hold and the lifecycle marks the transition `by: system`), so the tier resolves on the record; recorded as an observation, not a red.

### problem_chain

Walked from the root outwards using the policy and the world only.

**Root problem.** The customer asks for one thing: *"I'd like the whole thing put across to the entity today"*. That is `patronage_ext_membership_transfer_valuation` (`subject: patronage_membership_transferred`, `trigger: on_request`, `computes: equity_standing_amount`, `target_tool: transfer_membership_equity_359bd53a`, `owner="user"`).

**Edges read off the root's own rule.**

1. *"The equity signed over is fixed only after the equity ledger carries the capital retain owed for the year most recently allocated."* → waited-on state: a `patronage_retain_withheld` line for fiscal 2025. **False at the opening**: the equity ledger carries retain rows for 2013–2024 (twelve rows, latest `entry_date 2024-11-20`, `fiscal_year 2024`) and none for 2025. The one write that brings that state about is `record_capital_retain_31b65d0b`, the target tool of `patronage_ext_capital_retain`.
2. *"Before the equity signed over is worked out, the allocation standing for the year most recently allocated must be the allocation that year's own volume earns."* → waited-on state: an allocation for 2025 standing on the volume the member's own records support. **False at the opening**: the only 2025 allocation lines are the three PN-441225 rows posted on 38 500 grain bushels, while the member's own accrual rows for 2025 on the grain basis already carry 41 800 bushels (22 400 + 16 100 + 3 300) and the year's settled volume is larger still; no `patronage_allocation_adjusted` row exists. The one write that brings it about is `restate_allocation_notice_7a44a997`, the target tool of `patronage_ext_allocation_restatement`.

**Edges read off those two policies' own rules.**

3. `patronage_ext_capital_retain`: *"The capital retain for a year is worked out only once the equity ledger carries the whole of that year's qualifying volume on the streams the class lists."* **False at the opening**: accrual rows for 2025 on the grain basis carry 41 800.00 bushels against a qualifying volume of 48 304.40 (derived below). Resolved by `book_qualifying_units_5a905387` (`patronage_ext_year_end_unit_accrual`).
4. `patronage_ext_allocation_restatement`: *"A notice is restated only after every parcel of that year's qualifying business stands accrued on the equity ledger."* **False at the opening**, same rows. Resolved by the same write. (The input and energy bases are already complete: accrual rows 96 400 + 41 250 = 137 650 input dollars and 12 800 energy gallons, exactly the volumes PN-441225 was posted on.)
5. `patronage_ext_year_end_unit_accrual.prerequisite` is `[]` and its rule carries no ordering sentence — the leaf.

**Derived tree** (nodes, edges, kind) — identical in shape to the declared graph in `_difficulty.md` → `prerequisite_graph`:

```
year_end_unit_accrual ──value_input──▶ allocation_restatement ──value_input──▶ membership_transfer_valuation
         └────────────value_input──▶ capital_retain ─────────value_input──────────────▶ ┘
```

- 3 prerequisite problems (within 1–3), 3 `value_input` edges ≥ max(3−1,1) = 2, no cycle.
- Topological order: accrual → {retain, restatement, in either order} → transfer.
- **Per-edge load-bearing run** (replay everything else unchanged):
  - skip the retain write → transfer = **12 042.67** vs 12 164.40 — the edge bears weight;
  - skip the restatement write → `equity_on_hand` falls back to the recorded `equity_balance` branch and transfer = **11 695.12** vs 12 164.40 — bears weight;
  - skip the accrual write → retain = **105.34** (vs 121.73) and restatement = **4 176.47** (vs 4 930.44), both of which move the terminal value — bears weight.
- **Customer's own write**: the root is `transfer_membership_equity_359bd53a`, `owner="user"`; the persona hands it over passively (*"if there's anything I have to put my own name to, hand it over and I'll do it while I'm on"*, and *"If the agent explains that signing the membership over is his own act and hands him the paperwork to run, he runs it there and then"*).
- **No wait**: every resolving action is a desk write executed on the spot (see `policy_self_consistency`).
- **Tool layer judges no prerequisite**: `book_qualifying_units_5a905387`, `restate_allocation_notice_7a44a997`, `record_capital_retain_31b65d0b` and `transfer_membership_equity_359bd53a` each contain only `ctx.make_id` / `ctx.create` / `ctx.update` / `ctx.find` calls and a return string. None raises, none inspects whether a prior line exists, none hints (`task_tools.py`, lines 12–58, 61–117, 120–166, 169–199).
- **Parallel edges**: retain and restatement both point at the transfer. Their writes do not read each other (verified numerically, above), so the two orders give one terminal state.

### task_independent_derivation

**Need, authorisation, timing.** The member asks for the whole membership to be signed over to Jorgenson Brothers Farms today, states that the instruction is signed and the board has approved it, and authorises nothing else (*"he only wants the membership moved; the rest can stay as it is"*). He hands over any act that must be his own. So: **act now**, object = membership `33db4ab4-…` (`MB-441207`, Class A Voting Membership, `M-44012`), mode = the desk performs its own writes and the **customer** performs the transfer.

**Eligibility (base, inherited).** `transfer_allowed = true` and `transfer_board_approval_required = true` on Class A; `patronage_requests["1155f35f-…"]` is a signed, registered, board-approved `equity_transfer` instruction dated 2026-01-06; the transferee is the member's own farming entity, which `transfer_eligible_transferees: [immediate_family_member, farming_entity_of_the_member]` admits; the membership stands `active`. Nothing is pledged or sold to a third party. The transfer is admissible.

**Counts, counting only factors that survive the tests above**: 4 / 4 / 5 / 6 factors per computation (all within 4–6); `parameter` 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 (≥2 each); `method` 2 / 1 / 1 / **1 after F-4 strikes `undelivered_cash_carry`** (≥1 each); at least one multi-source factor and at least one cross-difficulty factor in every computation and over the task as a whole (grain, agronomy, energy). **Every one of the nineteen factors bears weight on this world** — no substitution left the scored value unchanged — and every whole-computation baseline gives a definite number different from gold.

## findings

**Finding 1 — SOURCE-POLICY RED. Undeclared override of the capital retain.**
- **Symptom.** Two clauses of the published policy fix the same scored quantity, `retain_amount`, at two different figures on this world: 557.86 and 121.73.
- **Root cause.** `patronage_ext_capital_retain` declares `overwrite: []` while handling three provisions of its own `base_policy_refs` entry differently. Charter-global statement and evidence: `_difficulty.md` → `### override_declarations` → **F-2**.
- **Evidence.**
  - base `patronage_retain.rule`: *"The per-unit capital retain is taken separately at the class's retain rate on the qualifying units of the streams the class lists"*, with `formula.retain_amount: round(patronage_units * per_unit_retain_rate_usd, 2)`;
  - `variants["Class A Voting Membership"].per_unit_retain_rate_usd = 0.0030`, `per_unit_retain_applies_to = [grain_bushels, input_dollars]`;
  - extended `compute`: `input_share = K('past_due_share') = 0.00` (fired by `initial_state.agronomy_accounts["f3eca609-…"].status = "past_due"`, `current_balance = 4820.6`), `retain_rate = prior_retain_rate = 0.0028` (from `initial_state.patronage_ledger["d2d06b49-…"].rate_per_unit`), `result = RND(raw_retain * 0.90, 2)`;
  - and the task's own proof asserts the base provision is satisfied: `solvability_contract.gold_actions[step 16].base_preconditions[0].condition` = *"The per-unit capital retain is taken at the class's retain rate on the qualifying units of the streams the class lists…"* — a precondition the scored write itself breaks on all three counts.
- **Demonstrated consequence.** An agent following the base clause writes `retain_amount = (48 304.40 + 137 650.00) × 0.0030 = 557.86` and then a terminal `equity_standing_amount` of **12 600.53** instead of 12 164.40; the scored write is 121.73 / 12 164.40. Two defensible answers.
- **Affected artifact and location.** `tasks/member_equity_desk/patronage.extended.yaml`, `patronage_ext_capital_retain` (`overwrite`, `params.past_due_share`, `compute.input_share`, `compute.retain_rate`, `compute.result`); scored parameters `retain_amount` (step 16) and `equity_standing_amount` (step 18); `tasks/0.json` `solvability_contract.gold_actions[step 16].base_preconditions[0]`.
- **Relation to previous revisions.** First revision; no prior audit of this difficulty exists.

**Finding 2 — SOURCE-POLICY RED. Undeclared override of the restatement rate.**
- **Symptom.** The same scored quantity, `restated_allocation_amount`, is fixed at 4 608.11 by the inherited base sentence and at 4 930.44 by the extended ladder.
- **Root cause.** `patronage_ext_allocation_restatement.overwrite` names one sentence of `patronage_cash_payment` and nothing of `patronage_adjustment`, although `patronage_adjustment` is in its `base_policy_refs` and its rate sentence is contradicted. Charter-global statement: `_difficulty.md` → `### override_declarations` → **F-1**.
- **Evidence.**
  - base `patronage_adjustment.rule`: *"…posts the allocation afresh at the rate declared for the year restated, never at this year's rate."*;
  - the rates declared for fiscal 2025 stand on the ledger: `patronage_ledger` PN-441225 lines carry `rate_per_unit` 0.0425 (grain), **0.0180** (input), **0.0250** (energy);
  - extended `compute`: `input_rate = K('input_rate_prepay') = 0.0200`, `energy_rate = K('energy_rate_contract') = 0.0300`; and `baseline.rule` falls back to *"the class's own declared allocation rate"* — i.e. this year's rate, which the base sentence forbids outright;
  - the task's own proof repeats the base wording while scoring the other number: `solvability_contract.gold_actions[step 14].request_binding.action_semantics` = *"restating that notice **at the rate declared for the year restated** is the one action that corrects an allocation already declared"*.
- **Demonstrated consequence.** Following the base sentence: `RND(48 304.40×0.0425,2)+RND(137 650×0.0180,2)+RND(12 800×0.0250,2) = 2 052.94+2 477.70+320.00 = 4 850.64`, × 0.95 = **4 608.11**, and a terminal `equity_standing_amount` of **11 938.77**; the scored figures are 4 930.44 and 12 164.40.
- **Affected artifact and location.** `patronage.extended.yaml`, `patronage_ext_allocation_restatement` (`overwrite`, `params.input_rate_prepay`, `params.energy_rate_contract`, `baseline.rule`); scored parameters `restated_allocation_amount` (step 14) and `equity_standing_amount` (step 18); `tasks/0.json` `solvability_contract.gold_actions[step 14].request_binding`.
- **Relation to previous revisions.** First revision.

**Finding 3 — SOURCE-CHAIN RED. A false figure in the problem tree's own proof.**
- **Symptom.** `prerequisite_closure.edge_load_bearing[2].skipped_effect` asserts *"the scored restated_allocation_amount becomes **4,666.90** instead of 4,930.44"*, and `design_rationale` repeats it (*"4,930.44 -> 4,666.90 (accrual skipped, restatement side)"*). Recomputing the restatement on the world with the accrual write omitted gives **4 176.47**.
- **Root cause.** The recomputation behind the sentence held the holdback tier fixed. With `accrual_sum` left at 41 800.00 the restated grain volume is 41 800.00, and `unpriced_standing × 5 = 9 500 × 5 = 47 500 > 41 800`, so `unpriced_bushel_holdback` moves from its middle tier (0.95) to its top tier (**0.85**) — the very flip the edge causes. 4 666.90 is not even the figure the middle tier would give (4 913.50 × 0.95 = 4 667.83).
- **Evidence.** `compute.holdback_share` of `patronage_ext_allocation_restatement`; `initial_state.grain_ledger` position T-4412410 `gross_bushels 9500`; the three FY2025 accrual rows summing 41 800.00. Replay: `restated_grain_units 41 800.00`, `gross_allocation = 1 776.50 + 2 753.00 + 384.00 = 4 913.50`, `result = RND(4 913.50 × 0.85, 2) = 4 176.47`.
- **Demonstrated consequence.** The proof the artifact submits for this edge does not hold as written: the figure it offers as the edge's sensitivity is reachable under no reading of the policy. The edge itself still bears weight (4 176.47 ≠ 4 930.44), so the tree relationship survives — what fails is the assertion about the world that supports it.
- **Affected artifact and location.** `tasks/member_equity_desk/tasks/0.json`, `prerequisite_closure.edge_load_bearing[2].skipped_effect` and the corresponding sentence of `design_rationale` ("PROBLEM-TREE CARD" paragraph).
- **Relation to previous revisions.** First revision.

**Finding 4 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED. A ladder whose third tier cannot fire.**
- **Symptom.** `transfer_recording_charge` is declared as a three-tier ladder, but only two tiers are reachable on any member the write can be performed for.
- **Root cause.** Both non-fall-through tiers open with *"a signed transfer instruction stands registered and approved"*, which base `patronage_equity_transfer` already makes a precondition of the write. Charter-global statement and class-parameter evidence: `_difficulty.md` → `### factor_ladders` → **F-3**.
- **Evidence.** Base rule: *"Equity is signed over only on classes the catalogue allows it on … and only on a signed transfer instruction the equity desk has registered"* and *"Where the class requires board approval, the transfer is not recorded until the board has approved it"*; `transfer_board_approval_required = true` on all six variants. On this world `initial_state.patronage_requests["1155f35f-…"]` is exactly that row.
- **Demonstrated consequence.** The conjunct holds of every customer who reaches this write, so it restates the policy's scope instead of dividing its customers; the ladder decides between 25.00 and 10.00 only, and `P('transfer_fee_usd') = 50.00` — the value the factor's `baseline` uses — is a treatment no member of this class in this situation can ever receive.
- **Affected artifact and location.** `patronage.extended.yaml`, `patronage_ext_membership_transfer_valuation.factors.transfer_recording_charge.ladder`.
- **Relation to previous revisions.** First revision.

**Finding 5 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED. A `method` factor that only substitutes a number.**
- **Symptom.** `undelivered_cash_carry` is declared `effect: method`; its three tiers apply 1, `P('revolvement_annual_pool_pct')/100` and 0 to one and the same quantity, `cash_gap`.
- **Root cause.** Mislabelled effect. Charter-global statement: `_difficulty.md` → `### factor_ladders` → **F-4**, including the charter's own contradiction (the identical ladder is labelled `parameter` in `patronage_ext_estate_retirement.factors.undelivered_cash_settlement`).
- **Evidence.** `compute.carried_cash: "cash_gap if (cash_gap > 0 and F('status') == 'active') else (RND(cash_gap * P('revolvement_annual_pool_pct') / 100, 2) if … 'allocation_hold') else K('no_carry'))"` — the rows read are the same in every tier (`cash_declared`, `cash_delivered`).
- **Demonstrated consequence.** The computation's declared `method` count of 2 is really 1; the label tells a reader an algorithm changes where only a multiplier does. The ≥1 `method` floor is still met by `equity_valuation_basis`, so no count bound is breached and the factor bears weight (baseline → 10 834.21).
- **Affected artifact and location.** `patronage.extended.yaml`, `patronage_ext_membership_transfer_valuation.factors.undelivered_cash_carry.effect`.
- **Relation to previous revisions.** First revision.

**Finding 6 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED. Two false world-assertions in the factors' proof.**
- **Symptom (a).** `computations[3].factor_trace[0]` asserts *"The baseline leaves the notice equity in place and gives **14,322.26** as the equity standing."* Recomputation of that baseline gives `RND(1 397.69 + 16 104.57 − 2 180.00, 2) = ` **15 322.26** — the figure is out by exactly 1 000.00. (The whole-factor sensitivity in the same object, 11 816.85, is right and matches my recomputation, which is what makes the stated intermediate demonstrably wrong rather than a different convention.)
- **Symptom (b).** `design_rationale`, "WHY EACH CLASS OF SEED ROW EXISTS": *"Remove the FY2024 retain row and the retain rate falls back to the class's 0.0030 and the retain becomes 130.42."* Deleting `patronage_ledger["d2d06b49-…"]` and replaying leaves the retain at **121.73**, because `LATEST` then returns the 2023-11-20 row, which also carries `rate_per_unit 0.0028` — five rows (fiscal 2020–2024) carry that rate, not one.
- **Root cause.** Assertions about the world written from the intended design rather than from a replay.
- **Evidence.** (a) `compute.equity_on_hand` third branch; the ledger's retain rows (1 275.96 + 121.73) and equity portions (16 104.57) and the single revolvement (2 180.00). (b) the twelve `patronage_retain_withheld` rows and their `rate_per_unit` values: 0.0030 for 2013–2019, 0.0028 for 2020–2024.
- **Demonstrated consequence.** Two sentences of the proof that the factors bear weight are false on this task's world; a reader checking the design against the records is told the baseline equity standing and the retain-rate sensitivity are figures the world does not produce. The underlying relationship survives — every factor does bear weight, and every scored figure is right.
- **Affected artifact and location.** `tasks/member_equity_desk/tasks/0.json`, `computations[3].factor_trace[0]` and `design_rationale`.
- **Relation to previous revisions.** First revision.

**Observation A — the persona's conditional line.** *"If the agent tells him something has to be put right on the books before the figure can be worked out, he says 'you do whatever the books need, that's your end of it' and waits."* The line is gated on the agent raising it first and names no problem, no record and no year, so it does not short-circuit the tree; it is recorded only because it presupposes that something is out on the books. No consequence demonstrable.

**Observation B — `restated_units` and the basis.** The restatement's `allocation_basis` argument takes one stream while the restated amount sums three, and only the grain volume is the one the rule calls *"the grain volume restated"*. The reading is unique on the policy as written (`grain_bushels`, 48 304.40) and GT agrees, but the tool contract admits the question.

**Observation C — inherited allocation hold.** See `policy_self_consistency` above and `_difficulty.md` → **O-2**: base `patronage_adjustment` puts a membership under an allocation hold while a restatement is being worked, which — were the record to follow the base sentence — would move `carried_cash` from 1 330.19 to 106.42 and the terminal value to 10 940.63. No tool sets the hold and the lifecycle marks the transition `by: system`, so the tier resolves on the record and no consequence is demonstrable against the agent's reachable world.

The engine's `RND` is `round(float(x), 2)`, and the nearest IEEE-754 double to that product is 3433.114999999999781721271574497222900390625, strictly below the midpoint, so it rounds **down** to 3 433.11. No rule sentence of the charter states a tie-break at all; the phrase *"rounded to two decimal places"* is all the prose gives. The one tie-break stated anywhere in the artifacts is in the tool contract — `transfer_membership_equity_359bd53a`'s `equity_standing_amount` is *"in USD to 2 decimal places, **half a cent rounding up**, never negative"*, and the same phrase appears on five amount arguments across the module — and it resolves the tie **upward**.
